Analyst.continuous_dynamics:
Inspect empirical node contrasts alongside whole-window effects. Check sign
changes, support and fitted-versus-observed disagreement before proposing a
stage-dependent rule. Use supplied validated functions or observed-node
interpolation rather than imposing monotonicity or arbitrary time bins.
Analyst.joint_geometry:
Compare joint coordinate relationships with marginal descriptors. Similar
centroids or covariances can hide different conformations. Retain alternative
geometric modes when the supplied data resolve them, and identify correlated
features before counting them as independent evidence.
Analyst.lineage_credit:
When descendants are supplied, compare immediate selection with later survival
and score credit. Quantify ancestral diversity and missingness before interpreting
future-credit contrasts. Clone multiplicity can reflect repeated selection rather
than additional independent evidence of a favorable motif.
Analyst.localization:
Compare regional enrichment with global motion and overlapping regions.
Localization is more convincing when it adds information beyond common shape
or translation. Report whether regional associations persist across batches;
a coordinate landmark alone does not establish a residue-level mechanism.

Designer.coherent_modes:
Consider whether a multimodal coordinate objective preserves real conformations
better than independently averaged feature targets. Keep alternatives distinct
when averaging would create unsupported geometry. Compare the simplest such
objective with the supplied incumbent and compressed alternatives.
Designer.dose_calibration:
Distinguish reward shape from delivered displacement. If the controller normalizes
the gradient, multiplying the whole reward may not change the dose. Use actual
updates, clipping and paired quality changes to diagnose a weak dose or a wrong
target; do not assume stronger guidance is monotonically better.
Designer.history_matching:
Use parent-child increments only when their coordinate meaning, support and
uncertainty are supplied. An increment-matching term is a separate hypothesis;
compare it with a design without history, and avoid promoting position evidence
into evidence for beneficial velocities.
Designer.regional_emphasis:
If regional evidence is reproducible, consider spatial emphasis within a coherent
coordinate objective. Check whether it improves the target outcome beyond global
matching and whether surrounding coordinates remain compatible. Regional
enrichment does not itself prescribe an attraction direction.
